analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 판정 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출했으나 50 이상 회복 미흡. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세이나 여전히 음수 구간. SMA200 대비 -17.25% 하락으로 중장기 이평선 하방 압력 지속. 5일 저가 28,235원 대비 현재가 30,115원으로 Higher Low 패턴 초입 진입. 스윙 지지선 29,960원 근접 시 매수 고려.
analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see decision maintained. RSI has exited oversold but has not yet recovered above 50. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains in negative territory. Down 17.25% from SMA200, indicating continued downward pressure from medium-to-long term moving averages. Entering the initial phase of a Higher Low pattern with the current price of 30,115 KRW compared to the 5-day low of 28,235 KRW. Consider buying on approach to the swing support at 29,960 KRW.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + consider buying on approach to swing support at 29,960 KRW, expect further upside on breaking resistance at 30,570 KRW
